_docs.overview: Ship and weapon configuration. Ship archetypes are selected by the `value` budget argument (RU). Weapon classes are selected via weighted random from probability values. All values mirror current C++ hardcoded defaults — Phase 1 is read-only (no behavior change).
_docs.how_to_use: C++ factories (ShipType.cpp, WeaponType.cpp) read these values at ship creation time. Archetype overrides defaults per value range. Weapon class probabilities control which weapon types are generated.

field_reference.defaults.hullValueRatio: Fraction of total budget allocated to hull (0.6 = 60%)
field_reference.defaults.shieldValueRatio: Fraction of remaining budget allocated to shield (0.3 = 30% of non-hull)
field_reference.defaults.scannerValue: Fixed scanner value in RU (always allocated, not subtracted from budget)
field_reference.defaults.thrusterCount: Base thruster pair count (directional thrusters added on top)
field_reference.defaults.turretCount: Number of turret sockets on hull surface
field_reference.defaults.shieldChargeTime: Seconds to fully recharge depleted shield
field_reference.defaults.shieldRestoreFraction: Fraction of max shield HP restored on recharge tick
field_reference.defaults.shieldColor: RGB tint for shield ripple shader
field_reference.defaults.shieldIdleOpacity: 0 = invisible when not hit (current), >0 = visible field
field_reference.defaults.hullTint: RGB multiplier for hull albedo (Phase 3 — not yet wired)
field_reference.defaults.thrusterColor: RGB for thruster trail and glow (Phase 3 — not yet wired)
field_reference.shipArcheTypes.*.valueRange: [min, max] budget in RU. Archetype auto-selected by value.
field_reference.shipArcheTypes.*.compactnessMult: Mass multiplier. Higher = lighter = more agile.
field_reference.shipArcheTypes.*.integrityMult: Hull health multiplier. More HP = survives longer.
field_reference.weaponClasses.*.ammoProbabilityMult: Weight for class selection. 0 = disabled. Sum need not be 1.
field_reference.balance.armorDamageReduction: Percentage reduction per armor rating point (0.05 = 5%).
